vision.name: Saiyan Enhanced Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Whenever one of your Styled effects destroys non-Dragon Ball cards from your opponent's Life Deck, you may banish them instead. Twice per combat, when you perform a Styled attack, you may destroy the top card of each player's Life Deck.
POWER: Choose up to 2 Styled [Attack] and/or [Defense] cards in your discard pile and Rejuvenate them. You may raise a player's anger 1.
